ambiguities.description: It's unclear whether a Student can enroll in an Offering before grades are assigned (i.e., is there an 'Enrollment' concept distinct from the grade record)? The transcript conflates enrollment and grading into a single fact ('receives a letter grade for each course offering they were enrolled in'), but doesn't describe enrollment as a separate event with its own timing/status prior to grade assignment. Should Enrollment be modeled as its own objectified entity with attributes like enrollment date, separate from the grade?

source_references.excerpt: At the end of a semester, a student receives a letter grade for each course offering they were enrolled in.

ambiguities.description: The maximum capacity is described as 'usually between 1 and 6' for credit value and capacity itself has no stated bounds. Is there a hard minimum/maximum for MaximumCapacity, or is it unconstrained?

ambiguities.description: The credit value constraint is stated as 'usually between 1 and 6' -- is this a hard business rule (enforced value constraint) or just a typical range with exceptions allowed? This affects whether it should be a strict value_constraint or just documentation.

source_references.excerpt: The credit value is a whole number, usually between 1 and 6.

ambiguities.description: It is not explicitly stated whether an Instructor can teach offerings across multiple semesters or only within the same semester as mentioned; also unclear if an Instructor must teach at least one Offering (mandatory participation on the Instructor side) or can exist with zero offerings.
